My rescue dog unfortunately had a rough start to life and is very reactive to strangers, specifically men. Her rough start began in 2024 when a MOP found her straying with a very serious wound to her neck, she was brought into MyVet Lucan and they saved her life before she was transported to the NSPCA.
Her surgeon, Ciaran, was amazing with her from day 1 and was more than happy to treat her, regardless of her temperament. The entire team in MyVet Lucan have treated her with such kindness and compassion, to the extent that she is comfortable with them!
The team are incredibly professional and are clearly all animal lovers. I could not recommend them enough, especially if your dog is nervous! The reception staff and nurses are all great as well, the whole team helped me with the pet insurance to receive a claim. Fantastic staff and vet practise.

Wonderful staff, they were able to get us on same day for an emergency. They have the ability do diagnostics a surgery via endoscopy, saving our pup from an uncomfortable surgery. Free available parking. Very clean and helpful.

We had a generally positive experience in terms of the service and the staff’s care and attention. However, our dog was suffering from severe itching and discharge in his ear. Initially, a medication treatment was prescribed, but unfortunately, the problem did not completely resolve.

What disappointed us most was that we were never given a clear explanation of what was causing the ear problem. Later, we contacted a trusted vet in our home country and explained the symptoms. The medication prescribed by that vet completely resolved the itching and discharge.

While we appreciated the care and attention we received, we expected a more thorough investigation into the cause of the problem and a clearer explanation of the diagnosis and treatment. Unfortunately, for this reason, we do not plan to return.

I have waited more than seven months before writing this review because my dog Mario died following this visit, and I wanted time to reflect on the experience rather than write in the immediate aftermath of losing him.

In the early hours of St Stephen’s Day 2025, I phoned the emergency out of hours service because Mario was extremely unwell. I felt I was being encouraged to wait until approximately 10am, when the practice opened normally. I was not comfortable waiting and insisted on bringing him in. I told them I was leaving with him, gave an approximate arrival time and called again when I was outside to be let in.

Despite knowing we were coming with an extremely unwell dog, we then had to wait over 20 minutes before Mario was brought through for examination. He was clearly very unwell and barely responsive. What has stayed with me is the amount of discussion about costs while he was lying on the examination table. It was only after Mario dry-heaved that IV fluids were started.

Mario remained there for the following few hours. His records indicate that he was monitored, and I accept that he may have received very good care after I left. However, my concerns did not develop afterwards because he died. While Mario was still alive and being treated, I was uneasy enough following an update that I contacted a vet in my hometown of Kilkenny for independent advice on whether his treatment sounded appropriate. I even considered collecting Mario and taking him elsewhere. Unfortunately, he deteriorated rapidly and I was called back in. Despite attempts to save him, Mario died that night.

I am not a veterinary professional and cannot say that anything different would have saved Mario. My concern is how his initial emergency presentation was handled, and something about that experience has never sat right with me.

After leaving the room at around 3am, having just said goodbye to a dog I had loved for more than twelve years, I was immediately asked to settle a substantial bill. I understand that veterinary treatment and cremation costs have to be paid, but the timing added to an already devastating experience.

Afterwards, I repeatedly had to chase the practice for both Mario’s clinical records and an itemised bill. I ultimately had to raise my legal rights before finally receiving his records. Having to pursue this documentation while grieving him caused further unnecessary distress.

I appreciate that emergency veterinary medicine is difficult, costs need to be discussed and sadly not every animal can be saved. I am not claiming that a different approach would necessarily have changed Mario’s outcome. This review reflects my experience of his initial emergency presentation and the subsequent communication and administration.

More than seven months later, I remain uncomfortable with what happened. I cannot say every aspect of Mario’s care was poor, particularly as his records show he was monitored after I left. However, the overall experience left me with such a lack of confidence in this practice that I would never entrust another one of my dogs to their care again.
Thank you for the lovely 5 star review Andrei

Following the untimely death of my 10-year-old Yorkshire Terrier, Baba, after his care at MyVet Lucan, I am writing this review to express my deep regret at ever bringing him there.

Baba had been diagnosed by my own vet with diabetes, a related urinary tract infection, and signs of pancreatitis and mild hepatitis. My vet strongly recommended MyVet Lucan for “the best care possible”. I specifically asked whether Baba’s diagnosis was a death sentence and was told it was not.

During the first night and day, Baba appeared to respond very well. I received reassuring updates saying he had eaten, was in good form and was a happy little dog. I genuinely believed he was going to be okay.

On the third day, I was asked to come in because he would not eat for the staff. When I arrived, I was shocked to find a completely different dog. Baba was distressed, crying and walking into the wall. I could not understand what had happened since the positive update the previous day.

I was left alone with him for over an hour before seeing a vet. When she eventually came in, the consultation felt rushed because she said she had to attend an emergency. I repeatedly asked what had changed and why Baba appeared to be in pain and neurologically affected. I was told he had been given a strong opioid.

After Baba ate for me, I asked why nobody was present to administer his insulin. Despite his condition, I left him there because I still believed he was receiving specialist care. I emailed the practice that evening outlining my concerns and received no reply.

The following morning, I received a generic text saying he had been stable overnight. I waited for a promised call that never came. After repeatedly trying to contact the practice for hours, I eventually got through at approximately 2.30 pm.

I was told Baba might have a brain tumour and that a CT scan would cost approximately €1,500. When I asked what opioid he had received, I was told it was methadone.

I was extremely concerned that a 6 kg Yorkshire Terrier with diabetes, pancreatitis and liver concerns had been given methadone, particularly because his severe change in behaviour appeared after it was administered. Instead of receiving a clear explanation of the medication, its risks and whether it could have contributed to his condition, I felt the focus moved immediately to a possible brain tumour.

When I asked what my other options were, I was told euthanasia was an option.

I immediately drove to Lucan and removed Baba from their care. Again, the vet said she was in a hurry to attend another emergency. I was left wondering why my own dog’s dramatic deterioration was not being treated with the same urgency. I also had to ask for his medication and felt I might otherwise have been allowed to leave without it.

I brought Baba to another veterinary hospital, where he received intensive treatment and every effort was made to save him. After reviewing his blood results, I was informed that he had gone into liver failure and that there was no realistic hope of recovery. I strongly believe this could account for the neurological signs I had witnessed. Sadly, I had to let my boy go four days later.

I am devastated and left with serious unanswered questions about Baba’s treatment, the lack of communication, the failure to respond to my concerns and his dramatic deterioration while under their care.

Baba was not simply a pet. He was a rescue, my family and my constant companion for almost ten years. I trusted this practice with his life and deeply regret that decision.

In my experience, the focus appeared to be on increasingly expensive investigations rather than clear communication and compassionate, accountable care. I would strongly recommend seeking a second opinion before placing a seriously ill animal in the care of MyVet Lucan.

I would not recommend this practice. The reception staff and nurses I met were kind and compassionate, and I appreciated them during an extremely distressing time.

We have been bringing our Toy Poodles, Coco and Daisy, to MyVet Lucan, and we couldn't be happier with the care they receive.
We would especially like to thank the wonderful lady from the Emergency Department who was on duty on the evening of 28th June, at around 11:00 pm. Coco had gone into labour, and we called several times throughout the night. She was incredibly kind, patient and reassuring, explaining everything clearly and guiding us through a very stressful situation. Her support was absolutely invaluable, and we will always be grateful for her kindness and professionalism.
We would also like to thank the amazing vets Claire, Emma and Jenny. We have had appointments with each of them, and every single visit has been professional, caring and compassionate. They always take the time to explain everything and genuinely care about the wellbeing of our dogs.
The reception team is always welcoming, friendly and helpful, and we truly appreciate how approachable everyone is. We also feel that the clinic is honest, transparent and offers fair pricing, which means a lot to us.
Thank you to the entire MyVet Lucan team for always taking such wonderful care of Coco, Daisy and their puppies. We highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care. ❤️🐾

Sam took my call today, dealt with my query, has a very nice telephone manner, very helpful, very clear and great patience as I had alot of questions. Offered further assistance by emailing me the details, he read back my email address to confirm correct details, very professional customer service. Thank you Sam.

Happy Birthday to Diego, 6 today, and a big thank you to MyVetLucan for their continued care to our big boy! I think it says everything when he still gets extremely excited when we tell him he is going to see Jenny who never complains about the excessive drool he leaves behind!!  Thanks to the reception staff also who are helpful and always with a smile and a friendly hello.

Our one year old Poochon Penny got ill very quickly with vomiting and diarrhea. She was completing lethargic so we were very concerned. Rang our own vets PVH to which we were told sorry there’s nothing we can do as we are busy, so I googled and found myvet lucan and rang them. The guy on the phone was so nice to us and completely looked after us we got an apt for 4:30pm. We arrived at the clinic and the reception area is so warm and welcoming and spotless clean. We felt so comfortable and the reception staff were just so nice as we were obviously worried sick. The vet called penny by her name when it was her turn to be seen and she completely checked her top to bottom, gave her an injection and follow up meds and the next day Penny was so improved. We will be moving both of our dogs from our current vets to myvet Lucan. Thank you for totally looking after us all

My Vet in Lucan were amazing to me and my family when we saying a final goodbye to our Husky, Rodney. We only brought him in for an emergency visit / check up and his legs were going from behind. However, we found out he was in so much pain. Everything was done with respect, patience and empathy. We then came home from a week away to a beautifully thoughtful card with Rodneys paw prints and a cute nose print! He loved being kissed on the nose so that one ment a lot! We also got a few small jars with his hair in them. Thank you My Vet Lucan for going that extra mile.

Sinéad the Vet was amazing with our Maltichin Phil who had a grass seed in his ear! We attended the emergency vet tonight. Sinéad the vet knew straight away was so pleased with the attention to detail she had - she’s amazing at her job! Thank you!!

Very talented surgeons, nurses and excellent staff all helped with treatment for our dog's spiral compression and aftercare. Can't recommend the whole Team enough.....
A really great practice, from receptionists to vets.  Highly recommend!

After the extremely upsetting and traumatic experience of our dog suddenly losing the use of her back legs, we were referred to MyVet. From our very first appointment with Ciaran Jones, we were treated with genuine professionalism, compassion, and kindness.

Ciaran took the time to explain everything in detail, including the CT scan, the surgical procedure, the risks, and what to expect during recovery. At no point did we feel pressured to proceed with surgery. Instead, he gave us all the information we needed to make the best decision for our dog.

Throughout the entire process, communication was excellent. Ciaran called after the CT scan to explain the results and recommend surgery, and he phoned again after the operation to let us know everything had gone well. Our dog stayed in the hospital for two nights, and we received regular updates on her progress, which gave us great reassurance during an incredibly stressful time.

Since bringing her home, every question we've had has been answered promptly. We attended both the two-week and six-week post-operative check-ups, and once again Ciaran was fantastic. He was wonderful with our dog, patiently answered all of our questions, and clearly explained what to expect as her recovery continued. We never felt rushed during any appointment, and he always made sure we left feeling informed and reassured.

I also want to mention the reception team. Every receptionist we dealt with, whether in person, over the phone, or by email, was incredibly kind, compassionate, and helpful. They made a difficult experience much easier to navigate.

We're delighted to say our dog has made a full recovery and is back to her happy, energetic self. We genuinely can't recommend MyVet highly enough. What was one of the most stressful and emotional experiences we've ever been through was made so much more manageable thanks to the professionalism, empathy, and exceptional care shown by Ciaran and the entire team. We are so grateful for everything they did for our dog and for us.

My dog Molly was referred to My Vet Lucan. I’ve been in and out of there for nearly a week for tests and scans. Hugely impressed by everyone I met and the way Molly was treated like family. Can’t recommend them highly enough.

My cat has just received the all‑clear after six months of complex orthopaedic treatment, including a total hip replacement and knee surgery. Ciaran and the whole team were fantastic throughout— skilled, calm, and genuinely caring. Ciaran’s confidence and reassurance made a huge difference, and I always felt she was in the best hands. I was kept updated throughout and I am so grateful for everything they’ve done. I highly recommend My Vet Referrals. .

My dog recently passed away and while it was a difficult time, I’ll never forget the kindness, compassion and professionalism that we’ve received the weeks coming up to and until his end. He was a stubborn boy and we stumbled upon this clinic one night for an emergency and this became the only veterinary clinic he ever liked. So truly, thank you to everyone here.

I brought my dog here for an emergency,my dog was almost in cardiac arrest when I brought him here they left us standing outside with our dying dog for 3 minutes and another 5 minutes sitting in reception waiting for someone to come save him.They brought him to the back put him on oxygen.We then discussed what my dog needed they told me my dog needed to be kept in for 24hours while on an oxygen machine and it was very serious.So we asked how much it would cost the guys here told me €1000 for one night upfront,when we had said we simply didn’t €1000 the vet went of for 15 minutes.When the vet returned he said my dog was alert and off oxygen and breathing fine and he could go home,but it would cost €320 and told me couldn’t give back my sick dog until the €320 was payed upfront so eventually we wore able to get €320 upfront to get my dog back.Within 10 seconds of leaving the vet my dog was panicking again worse then before getting to the vets,later on when we returned home with our dog he was very sick we brought him to different vet.They wore very quick and  looked after my dog.They told us the best option was to put our dog down because it was to far gone now.I wouldn’t never bring my sick animal here again it resulted in us having to make the decision to put our dog down

The team are always kind, caring, and understanding. They genuinely care about the animals they look after and always take the time to make both me and my dog feel comfortable. Their professionalism, compassion, and attention to detail give me complete confidence that my dog is receiving the very best care. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for a fantastic vet practice

The vets and services are brilliant but the admin and in particular the claims processing is painfully slow Considering the cost of the services you would expect some level of efficiency Look after your patients please team 🙏 …

Thank you for the 5 star review!

Everyone at MyVet Lucan and MyVet Referrals is very friendly and helpful. The nurses and vets are understanding when your pet is sick, and they always remain calm, which is reassuring. They clearly explain what’s happening and why, and lay out all the available options. They’re also able to answer all my questions, which makes me feel confident and reassured.

Most importantly, they treat my dog with such care and attention that she always feels calm and safe.

Was happy they could do the laparoscopic spay on my girl. The vet (I think Callum) was SUPERB chatting, checking her over and she stood and let him do whatever needed. And the price of the spay was better than other places I had got a quote for a regular spay from.

But the nurses / reception team communication between each-other alone left a lot to be desired. One nurse said she had eaten. The next said she hadn’t. On collection they said she ate a little. Rang later to see if they happened to know what she ate / how much cuz she didn’t want her dinner. Was told she didn’t eat anything she was a bit stressed.

Then came the recovery suit disaster - was told they had put the recovery suit on her in surgery. Then they hadn’t. Went to collect her and offered to help whatever they were doing cuz she was stressed and making a fuss for 10 minutes. Was told no. They were fine. I got there and the women at reception said they had the recovery suit on. Someone comes out to debrief/ show me her meds, with a recovery suit which was not on her. How hard can it be to know if it’s on her or not?

On her check up 2 days later the nurse was nervous of her, fine she wasn’t happy by the sounds of it. I explained I can just give her pets and she will go in my lap for a belly rub. Nurse just gestured to to table and said pop her up there. Like she didn’t listen at all to what I just said. Decided to skip the 10 day Check and go elsewhere. Where the nurses were super with her and me working to make things easy for her.
Great facility and lovely caring staff. 24/7 care.

I'll never forget the kindness and compassion from MyVet Lucan during a very tough time. Truly went above and beyond and I'll forever be grateful to the staff, Ciara especially; an absolute treasure.

I am done with MyVet Lucan. I went in today for a basic flea treatment — something any reasonable vet can sort in minutes — and was told I’d need to pay a €70 consultation fee plus €30 for the actual treatment. All because they hadn’t seen my dog in six months. So instead of being rewarded for having a healthy pet, I’m essentially being penalised for it. Make it make sense.

This place has become a masterclass in squeezing every cent they can out of people. The attitude is cold, unhelpful, and blatantly money-driven. It’s no wonder many of their reviews are full of the same complaints — it’s a pattern, not a coincidence.

I walked out and went straight to Village Vets in Clondalkin. This was at 4:45pm on a Saturday, fifteen minutes before closing. They registered my dog, checked her thoroughly, and provided the treatment for about 25% of what MyVet tried to charge — quick, kind, and professional. Everything MyVet Lucan is not.

MyVet Lucan comes across as inflexible, overpriced, and completely lacking in basic customer care. The receptionist was vile as well. Today confirmed it: I won’t ever set foot in there again, and I wouldn’t recommend them to anyone who values honesty or fair treatment.

“The team are always so kind, professional and caring with my pet. I feel completely confident in the advice and treatment we receive.”

Very disappointing experience with MyVet Lucan!

I brought my cat here multiple times. On one visit a serious condition (later confirmed as FIP) was not investigated until I specifically asked for a fluid sample. Once confirmed, I was simply told they do not treat it, with no guidance on alternatives.
During a routine spay I was asked to approve an additional €150 test, only to be told afterwards that the sample was insufficient and no result was obtained.
Most recently I attended as an emergency due to repeated vomiting and pain. The consultation was extremely brief and I felt that very little history was taken. I was advised to hospitalise my cat for IV fluids and an X-ray, which cost €1000 for one day. Bloods showed critically low potassium. Despite this, I was told she was “better” and could be discharged, but she deteriorated at home.
It then took several days and multiple calls and emails to receive her test results and X-rays.
I understand that not every case has a simple outcome, but the communication, clinical follow-up and overall care fell far below what I expected, especially given the cost.
I cannot recommend this clinic! Very disappointing service!

Hi Terry, 
Thank you so much for the lovely 5 star review. We hope Buster s doing well. 
Kind Regards, 
Shauna, Lead Vet
Excellent service day and night.  Would be absolutely lost without this clinic. Best vet in Dublin by a long shot.

Unfortunately, I had to have my dog put down last year. He had been kept there overnight for two/three nights following unsuccessful treatment, which cost a small fortune. As a result, my current account was completely wiped.
Before we proceeded with putting him to sleep, I asked whether I could pay half of the outstanding balance immediately and the remainder on the following Monday, as I needed to go to the credit union to withdraw the rest. I was told over the phone that this was fine.
However, after my dog was put to sleep and I explained this arrangement to the person at reception, I was met with significant resistance. After a lot of back and forth (which included her taking instructions from the vet), I was told that if I did not pay the full amount immediately, they would not release my dog’s ashes.
This was deeply upsetting and, frankly, disgraceful. This was after paying a substantial sum for several days of care, treatment and medication that ultimately proved unsuccessful. At what was already an incredibly distressing time, the situation was handled with a complete lack of compassion.
If you can avoid this place, I would. The old vets in Lucan village were excellent, but this practice feels like a cold, hard business with zero heart. They made an awful experience even worse.
I try to avoid thinking about this as I miss my poor dog everyday, but it affected me so much at the time, around March 2025, that I feel obliged to write this review.
Attending for the last 4 years, great service from all the vets and staff.
Very friendly and efficient staff … a pleasure to visit .very helpful in an emergency situation.

Thank you to my vet Lucan for seeing my cat urgently. I couldn’t get an appointment for a few days and as soon as I phoned and explained her symptoms which were v concerning they let me come in that evening to see vet. All the staff there were lovely (receptionists, care assistants and the vet we seen)  vet Cormac was excellent with Marshie. Not out of the woods yet and will have to make a return visit but I really appreciated how quick they were in letting us come in that evening with her when we were so worried.

Out of hours service, busy weekend,  they accommodated our cat for an emergency just to find out the bill would have been up to 1100€. They advised to pay a deposit and leave the cat with them.
After 2 hours we had been called and informed they could do some blood tests but not the ultrasound as expected so we have to collect the cat and come another day.
At home our cat was lethargic,  in a state if shock . No medication was provided.
We weren't impressed by their service which is strictly profit orientated with uncompesionate vets and cold , unfriendly environment.
Our cat didn't move from her bed. We fed her and offer water with a pipette.
I don't know what happened when they collected the blood sample but for sure it was a frightening experience for our cat.
And we were their customers since 2009.
Very disappointed.
Thanks for taking good care of Georgia & Bodhi
Wonderful, caring and friendly service from Dr Marina late on Christmas Day. So grateful for excellent care given to our sick boy. Can’t thank her enough, I highly recommend this clinic!

Professional efficient vets without a doubt but 5 times the price for the same procedure as Kilkenny. They can't be trusted to prices for procedures. Agreed to a price with my wife for a complicated operation which thankfully our dog didn't need in the end. Then insisted we agreed to €2500 for the work they did. Even after listening to the phone call which they record where this price was agreed for the complicated operation. They ignored this and insisted we had aggred the fee no matter what they did, who would agreed to that. Then state €2500 was their base price for any referred consultation, madness. If you can go anywhere else do or expect a massive bill.

Update: You could accept their response of you don't look at all the other previous 1 star reviews. They have two type of reviews customers who obviously are loaded and the rest of us. They lie and cheat on prices and I'm far from the only one. They know they have you over a barrel with a sick dog so just fudge and cloud the prices and after the fact you can do nothing about it. My advice record all phone calls on prices of all the options offered and get a definite price on each option. Best of luck
The best vets by far, my dog Zeus actually loves going to the vets because of how well he’s taken care of. And they don’t make me feel like an idiot when explaining what needs to be done for Zeus.

There isn't enough words to describe how much I recommend the guys in MyVet Lucan, in any of the locations to be honest. I've used MyVet for the last number of years for my yorkie, unfortunately he had to be put asleep at 15 last month. The guys in Lucan were so careful and thoughtful in the process. Allowed me to take my time before we said our final goodbyes. Maeve, who was our vet that day was amazing and really made the whole process so peaceful.
They even sent out a personalised card with his paws/nose print and his hair after the fact.

I couldn't recommend these enough! Appreciate all the work and care they've put in over the years💙❤️
Great late night vets prompt to the point no messing around
They were extremely considerate and caring when I came in with my old cat, lovely people
5 Star service.
We hope Ali is well! 🐕🙏🏼 …

There arent enough words to be able to describe how much I recommend MyVet Lucan and my love for the entire team. I registered my dog Harley there when we moved to Dublin in 2019, she'd surgery as a puppy and was always terrified of the vets as a result but the whole team from reception, nurses to the vets were always so kind and welcoming to her and always made such a fuss of her coming around for pets and cuddles that she absolutely adored going in, if we passed it on our walk she would be absolutely disgusted if we didn't go in so she could say hi.
Unfortunately last month Harley did end up having emergency surgery and then because of her age declined and did a 2nd surgery which the team called and advised it would be not in her best interest to wake up. They did howeveer, take the time to close her back up and allowed me time with her for cuddles and there was no rush I just got to sit with her until I was ready (well readyish) for them to inject her. She was the handled with truly the most gentle and respectful care.
From day 1 it was so refreshing to see everyone there just genuinely loved animals because they actually do care. Harley was on the full plan with dental which was absolutely incredible and anytime she had something that wasn't covered by the plan, each vet would always run through if they think its necessary immediately or if you can wait a couple months but obviously if something changed to book it in, knowing that if they recommended something they were doing it because it genuinely needs to be done and knowing its not just an extra needless cost makes such a huge difference. While I would throw every cent I had for my girl, the fact that the vets actually consider owners don't have €500-1000 to just drop with no warning which is an experience we had previously and lots of friends have had in other place is huge.
We had seen most of the team over the 6 years she was registered and I never had a bad experience with a single one, they all loved on Harley as if she was their own, it is just so lovely to see people genuinely love what they do and as an owner the comfort knowing that they're in the job for the right reasons is so reassuring. The environment everytime was truly so warm and welcoming that if you want someone who will truly care for your family member like their own I would highly recommend. As I said I cannot sing their praises enough.
I would also once again like to thank every single member of the team for the years that Harley was cared for and loved, she was such a happy dog and seeing how much she loved being there and comfortable she felt and how she was fussed over back, even if we were just in to pick up a bag of dog food was so wonderful. Truly from the bottom of my heart thank you all so much (apologies for the essay but they truly are that incredible.)

all staff are young and students probably but obvious inexperience - - they haven't got a clue so embarrassing to see them consulting an animal no ideea whatsoever, they maybe know the basic - bunch of chancers
Good Verona practice with a comprehensive team of clinicians..parking can be restrictive and can be a source of stress

Money Over Your Dog

I had a very disappointing experience with this clinic.

My dog has an autoimmune condition that causes painful mouth ulcers, and she urgently needed a specific medication. Our regular vet, who often supplies medications to other clinics, was temporarily out of stock, so they gave us a prescription and advised us to try finding it elsewhere while they reordered.

When we contacted this clinic, they confirmed that they had the medication in stock. However, they refused to provide it because they hadn’t seen our dog themselves, even after our vet offered to speak with them directly and share her complete medical history.

To our vet clinic, they changed their explanation, saying they only had one bottle left and preferred to save it for their own patients.

In a common practice among clinics, providing medication upon prescription. this clinic refused, unless we PAID for a consultation.

It’s clear that the priority here is not the well-being of animals, but profit. Good for business, maybe, but not for your pet.

Tomorrow, it could be your dog. Be aware.

*Update*

The clinic just tried to contact me.

At first, I thought maybe they had reviewed the medication situation, or maybe they had received new bottles. Maybe there had been a misunderstanding. Or maybe they simply wanted to show empathy about my dog or offer me some suggestions, but no.

After waiting a few minutes, this lady explained exactly what had happened (as if I didn’t already know). I was actually glad she was honest about the facts, but then I realized what was really going on. So I asked, “Are you calling me just to say you will not provide the medicine?” That much I had already understood.

When I heard they were trying to contact me, I expected more. Without me even asking, she added that there were no more appointments available, almost as if to prove they weren’t just trying to earn consultation fees from me.

In the end, it became clear, they only called because they saw my review and probably wanted me to remove it. Well, it will stay right here. Very disappointing.

*Second update*
